name: Systems engineering
deliverables: Controlled architecture, executable budgets, interfaces, review decisions

name: Structure and mechanisms
deliverables: Parametric packaging CAD, drawings, structural analysis, deployer fit and inhibit design
closure: selected deployer ICD, vendor mechanical models, inspected fabrication

name: Electrical power
deliverables: Battery selection, MPPT, protection, inrush, heaters, aging, independent passivation
closure: supplier data, cell tests, measured loads, hazard closure

name: Avionics
deliverables: Reference BSP, reset supervision, RTC, storage integrity, latch-up protection, harness
closure: board verification, radiation assessment, target HIL

name: RF and spectrum
deliverables: TNC integration, antenna/deployment, receiver/PA, Doppler/desense and shutdown
closure: link budget, calibrated emissions, coordinated frequencies

name: Attitude control
deliverables: Sensor calibration, magnetic actuation, B-dot dynamics and sun incidence
closure: measured sensors, torquer current, dynamics validation

name: Thermal and radiation
deliverables: Transient conductive thermal model, TVAC correlation, TID/SEE assessment
closure: vacuum cooling evidence, materials/parts environment suitability

name: Flight software
deliverables: Portable core, static RTOS tasks, recovery, protected updates, persistent state

name: Language payload
deliverables: Pinned models/runtime, bounded inference, power supervision, telemetry acceptance
closure: cold-boot cycle energy, factuality corpus, thermal and radiation testing

name: Ground and operations
deliverables: Packet client, telemetry archive, signing service, console, backup station

name: Integration and support equipment
deliverables: Flatsat, fixtures, calibrated instruments, assembly travelers and campaign data
closure: funded hardware, test facilities, equipment calibration

name: Launch and disposal
deliverables: Spectrum filings, debris analysis, launch safety, transport, tracking and EOL

name: Program and funding
deliverables: Named team, quotes, resource-loaded schedule, reserves, partnerships
closure: committed institution, cash/in-kind agreements and independently reviewed estimate
